title: Synduality Echo of Ada Game to End Online Service in 2027
content:
Bandai Namco Europe announced on Monday that Bandai Namco Entertainment 's Synduality Echo of Ada game will end its online service after May 2027, and will transition to an offline version.

With the end of the online service, updates and events will no longer be available after the content scheduled for October.

Sales of in-game items including the "SYN COINS" tokens will end on December 18. The launch of the transfer of save data to local save data is also scheduled for December. The end date of the online service is scheduled to be announced in March 2027, and transition to the offline game is scheduled after May 2027.

The game launched on January 24, 2025 (January 23 in Japan) for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .

Sony describes the game:

The year is 2222. It has been years since Tears of the New Moon, a mysterious rain, poured and wiped out almost the entire human race. The poisonous rain gave birth to deformed creatures devouring for humans, and humanity fled from the danger. As means for survival, the humans then build an underground haven; Amasia. In this new built dystopian city, on a pursuit of maintaining their existence, they run into an Artificial Intelligence named Magus. Not knowing how things will work between them, the story of how Humans and AI coinciding and trying to find their truths begin.

The game is part of Bandai Namco Filmworks and Bandai Spirits ' Synduality project, which includes the television anime Synduality: Noir . The anime's first cours premiered in July 2023. Disney+ streamed the anime exclusively worldwide as it aired in Japan. Hulu streamed the anime in the U.S. The second cours (quarter of a year) premiered on the TV Tokyo , TV Osaka , TV Aichi , TV Setouchi , TV Hokkaido , and TV Q Kyuushuu channels in January 2024. Disney+ exclusively streamed the second cours starting a day later in Japan.

While the game is set in the year 2222, the anime is set 20 years after in 2242.

The franchise also has a manga spinoff titled Synduality: Ellie , focusing on the titular character, which launched in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine in July 2023. The second and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan in January 2025. Hiroshi Mishima drew the manga. The manga also has a novelization under Kadokawa 's MF Bunko J label.

The franchise also has a separate novel spinoff "photo story" titled Synduality: Kaleido , which launched in Hobby Japan 's Monthly Hobby Japan magazine in July 2023.

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Gets Anime
content:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret manga is getting an anime series. A visual was revealed, along with the main staff and cast, and an April 2027 release date. Studio Gekko is animating the series.

The voice cast consists of:

• Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno

• Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya

• Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

• Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato is directing the anime with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.

Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows: Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?! Source: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime official X (formerly Twitter) , Website © Kashiko Amane / Hakusensha / Blue Impulse/ StarryCube

title: Machibari, Juan Albarrán Each Launch New Manga on Manga One App
content:
Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app announced on Monday its new autumn serializations, which include new series by Machibari and Juan Albarrán .

Writer Machibari and artist Seseri's Mibun ga Gyakuten Itashimashite ( Somehow, Our Roles Were Reversed ) manga will launch on October 17. Itoko is credited with the character designs.

Spanish artist Juan Albarrán and Kо̄ta Matsuda will launch the Kyokuhoku Tengoku: Escape From The Far North (The Heavenly Prison of The Far North) manga on October 25.

Albarrán ended the Mangaka's Road to Japan manga on February 13. The manga launched on Comic Days in October 2025 with an English simulpub on Kodansha 's K MANGA service .

Albarrán is the artist for the Matagi Gunner manga. Shōji Fujimoto wrote the manga's story. The manga launched in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in 2022, and ended in its 11th and final compiled book volume, which shipped in June 2025.

Machibari 's Yomei Wazuka Dakara to Tsuihō Sareta Seijo Desu ga, Junrei no Tabi ni Detara Chō Kenkō ni Narimashita ( The Banished Saint's Pilgrimage: From Dying to Thriving ) and Kenka Bakaridatta Konyakusha ga Ikinari Dekiai Shite Kimasu ( All My Fiancé and I Did Was Fight, But Now He's All Over Me? ) novels have previously received manga adaptations. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes Komugi Awaya 's adaptation of The Banished Saint's Pilgrimage: From Dying to Thriving , and Shusuisha publishes Makoto Ayase 's manga adaptation of All My Fiancé and I Did Was Fight, But Now He's All Over Me? in English digitally.

title: Lone Wolf and Cub Deluxe Edition Manga Wins Ringo Award
content:
The first volume of the Deluxe Edition of the manga shipped on December 9.

The original manga centers on Ogami Ittō, who is an executioner for the Shogun. After he is framed and his wife murdered, he and his infant son Daigorō wander the country as assassins for hire, while also working toward their own revenge.

Koike and Kojima original serialized the manga from 1970-1976. Kojima died in 2000 and Koike died in 2019.

First Comics premiered the manga in English in May 1987. The series was one of the first manga published in North America, and the first manga to be released in North America on a monthly schedule. Dark Horse Comics began releasing the series in 2000 as the first manga series to be published in North America straight to graphic novels that corresponded with the Japanese releases. In 2013, Dark Horse began releasing the series in omnibus format. In 2017, the company announced a Gallery Edition reprint that was released in a single volume in July 2018.

The manga inspired six feature movies starring Tomisaburō Wakayama , four stage plays, and a television series. As of October 2017, Paramount had the rights to a separate English-language live-action film adaptation of the manga.

Dark Horse Comics has also released the New Lone Wolf & Cub sequel manga and the Western comic series Lone Wolf 2100 .

The manga recently inspired a kabuki stage play adaptation that ran at Kabukiza Theatre in Tokyo from June 3-25.

The Ringo Awards, named after the late comic artist Mike Wieringo, recognize achievements across the comic book industry, with categories ranging from Best Cartoonist and Best Series to Best Original Graphic Novel and Best Webcomic. Both fans and professionals choose the nominations, and final voting is limited to professionals working in the comics field. The the awards ceremony itself is open to both fans and industry members. 2026 marked the 10th annual awards.

title: Zero-sen Hayato Anime Scriptwriter Sō Kuramoto Dies at 91
content:
The official website of screenwriter Sō Kuramoto 's foundation Kuramoto Sō Kaiwai announced on Monday that he died on September 18 due to multiple organ failure. He was 91.

A private funeral service with only close relatives in attendance was held in accordance with the family's wishes. A memorial service will be held on November 3 at the Furano Theatre Factory in Hokkaido. More details of the memorial service will be revealed at a later date.

Screenwriter, playwright, and director Kuramoto (real name Kaoru Yamaya) was born in Tokyo in 1935. He joined Nippon Broadcasting System in 1959, after graduating from University of Tokyo . After leaving the company in 1963, he became an independent screenwriter, and started using the pen name Sō Kuramoto .

His notable works include the original story of the 1975 drama series Zenryaku Ofukuro-sama (Dear Mother), screenplay of the 1980 drama series Sayonara Oryū-san (Goodbye, Oryū-san), and original story and screenplay of the drama series Kita no Kuni kara (From the North Country), which aired from 1981 to 1982, among others. Kuramoto also wrote the screenplay for the 2024 film Umi no Chinmoku (The Silence of the Sea), which had been in development for 60 years.

In anime, Kuramoto wrote the script for the 1964 series Zero-sen Hayato , along with Akira Kōno and Tomio Sagisu .

title: Psyren TV Anime Reveals Ending Song by Who-ya Extended
content:
The anime will debut on Tokyo MX and BS11 on October 5 at 11:00 p.m., before airing later that evening on Sun TV . Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China.

Global Stage Hollywood will screen the world premiere for the second episode of the anime at the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival on October 3 at the Chinese Theater in Hollywood, California. The first episode will also screen its West Coast premiere during the event. The manga's original creator Iwashiro will be in attendance at the screening.

The anime stars:

• Rikuya Yasuda as Ageha Yoshin

• Mayuko Kazama as Sakurako Amamiya.

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Hiryu Asaga

• Sōma Saitō as Oboro Mochizuki

• Yukihiro Nozuyama as Kabuto Kirisaki

• Yūko Kaida as Matsuri Yagumo

• Nobuyuki Hiyama as Dolkey

Katsumi Ono ( Symphogear AXZ , Symphogear G , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V ) is directing the anime at Satelight . Shin Yoshida ( Naruto Shippūden , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! GX ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Akira Ōkuma ( Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ; Demon Lord, Retry! R ) is designing the characters. Composers include: Takashi Ōmama ( Mobile Suit Gundam Twilight AXIS , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , I Parry Everything ), and Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses ).

CLAN QUEEN performs the opening theme song "Warning!!"

REMOW describes the anime:

One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

REMOW stated the anime will fully adapt the manga through its conclusion.

Iwashiro serialized Psyren in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2007-2010. Viz Media released all 16 volumes in English from 2011 to 2014.

title: Manchuria Opium Squad Manga Resumes Serialization With New Artist Tsurushima
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for writer Tsukasa Monma and the late artist Shikako 's Manchuria Opium Squad manga announced on Monday that the manga will resume in this year's 45th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine , which will ship on October 5. The manga will continue serialization with Shikako 's successor, manga artist Tsurushima , who was their senior colleague while working as assistant for Yasuhisa Hara 's Kingdom manga.

Hara also shared the announcement on his X/ Twitter account. Hara stated that Shikako expressed before they died the hope that an artist from the Kingdom man ga would take over the artwork for Manchuria Opium Squad . Hara commended Tsurushima for their resolve to succeed Shikako and continue drawing the manga's art.

Manchuria Opium Squad will resume on October 5 with two chapters. The 12-page chapter 216 was originally planned to be 16 pages long. Shikako was able to complete 11 pages before they died. Monma arranged the 12th page, which does not feature any characters, and the assistant(s) who had been supporting Shikako drew the background. From chapter 217, the manga will take a new step with art by Tsurushima .

Weekly Young Magazine 's editorial department stated in the announcement that the manga's resumption is made possible by the thoughts and dedicated efforts of many people including Shikako 's family; Tsurushima , who respected a friend's final wish and took over the manga's art; writer Monma, who expressed their desire to continue the manga's story up to its conclusion; the assistants who provided production support; and the readers who believed and waited for the manga's return.

Monma and Shikako serialized the manga on Kodansha 's Comic Days service from April 2020 to September 2021. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine in September 2021, with its 43rd issue of 2021. Kodansha shipped the 22nd compiled book volume in November 2025.

Kodansha publishes the series in English on the K MANGA app.

Shikako died on November 8, 2025 due to choroidal melanoma, a rare form of cancer that develops in the eye. The artist wanted someone to complete the manga series in their place, and the Weekly Young Magazine staff stated then that they would respect Shikako 's wishes.

Writer Ryūki Ōnuma and Tsurushima launched the Shikyuuji: Kōkō Kyūji ni Asu wanai manga in Young Magazine in June 2023. The series then moved to Kodansha 's YanMaga Web manga site in December 2023, where it ended in January 2024. Tsurushima most recently drew the G okuaku Tensei ( Extremely Evil Reincarnation ) manga, which ended with its fourth volume that Kodansha shipped on July 17.

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Manga Gets TV Anime in April
content:
An X (formerly Twitter ) account opened on Monday to announce that a television anime of Kashiko Amane 's Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret ( Hōkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ) manga will premiere next April.

The main cast members are:

Hikaru Tōno as Rei Kuromiya

=LOVE idol group member Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You , Dropkick on My Devil! ) is directing the anime at Gekkō , and Fumihiko Shimo ( BOFURI: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense. , Full Metal Panic! , Infinite Stratos ) is overseeing and writing the series scripts. Kibidango 14-gō ( Azuma Tozawa , Wash It All Away ) is designing the characters. Satoru Kōsaki ( The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya , Monogatari Series, Aharen-san wa Hakarenai ) and monaca ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai , Star Driver , Wake Up, Girls! ) are composing the music. Ryō Aizawa ( Starry Cube ) is producing.

Yen Press publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

Amane has been serializing the manga on Hakusensha 's Young Anime Web site. Yen Press published the fourth manga volume in June.

title: Web Manga 'Houkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru' Gets TV Anime in Spring 2027
content:
Production company Starry Cube opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kashiko Amane 's Houkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ( Everyone's Darling Has a Secret ) web manga on Monday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will premiere in April 2027.

Cast Hiruno Hizashi: Reiji Kawashima ( Fumetsu no Anata e ) Rei Kuromiya: Hikaru Tono ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru ) Sakura Akai: Iori Noguchi (=LOVE) ( Hashiri Tsuzukete Yokatta tte. ) Sora Konno: Ami Maeshima ( BanG Dream! 2nd Season )

Staff Director: Hikaru Satou ( Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon 2nd Season chief animation director) Series Composition, Script: Fumihiko Shimo ( Clannad ) Character Design: Azuma Tozawa ( Kirei ni Shitemoraemasu ka. ) Music: Satoru Kousaki ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ), MONACA ( Summertime Render ) Studio: Gekkou Producer: Ryou Aizawa (Starry Cube) ( Yuusha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Ita node, Kokuhaku shitemita. )

Amane originally launched a preview serialization of the comedy romance manga in Young Animal magazine from July to August 2022. The series later began regular serialization on the Manga Park and Young Animal web service in September 2022. Hakusensha published the ninth volume on July 29.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in August 2024. The fourth volume went on sale on June 9.

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game Streams In-Depth Video Highlighting 'Showbiz'
content:
Sega began streaming an in-depth "showbiz" video for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century") on Friday. The video provides a detailed overview of finding musical inspiration, creating songs, and promoting shows in the game.

The game will explore different times and places in Japan's modern history, including Kokura, Fukuoka in 1915; Kure, Hiroshima in 1929; Minami, Osaka in 1943; Atami, Shizuoka in 1951; and the fictional neighborhood of Kamurocho (based on the Kabukicho neighborhood, and a constant setting of RGG Studio's Yakuza/Like a Dragon games) in Shinjuku, Tokyo in 1965.

Sega describes the game's story:

A 50-year saga of those with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. In 1915 San Francisco, a young boy, Makoto Daito, sneaks aboard a suspicious ship in the harbor under the cover of night. Born to an American father and a Japanese mother, Makoto faces harsh persecution due to his Asian heritage. After losing both of his parents, Makoto decides to travel to his mother's homeland, Japan, where a fateful encounter awaits. With nothing but the shirt on his back, Makoto soon learns, however, that his voyage across the Pacific is anything but a "free ride," and that this one choice will forever change the course of his life.

The cast includes:

• Yū Shirota as Makoto Daito

• Snoop Dogg as Orpheus

• Moeka Hoshi as Tae Matsumoto

• Tori Kelly as Suzy Day

• Akio Ōtsuka as Heigo Yashima

• Tokuma Nishioka as Kiyoshi Otsuru

• Satoshi Fujihara as Takashi

• Cordell Broadus as The Veiled Stranger

• Ado as Keiko Shirai

• Bunta Sugawara (model basis) and Takashi Ukaji (voice) as Genzo Iwaki

• Late American rapper Tupac

• Takaya Kuroda (who plays Kazuma Kiryu in Ryu ga Gotoku's related Yakuza/Like a Dragon series)

• Kouhei Tsuji

• Yasukaze Motomiya (who plays Kosei Shishido in the Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name game and Kazuma Kiryu in Nihon Tohitsu's live-action Like a Dragon Powered By Nihon Touitsu series)

Sega provided the following comment regarding the character Genzo Iwaki and the model for the character being based on the late actor Bunta Sugawara :

In STRANGER THAN HEAVEN , the late and legendary actor Bunta Sugawara appears. SEGA received formal consent from his family, and, with materials provided by Toei Company Ltd. —which produced many of Mr. Sugawara's films, including the Battles Without Honor and Humanity — RGG Studio crafted his CG character design based on archival footage and photographs from the time.

Snoop Dogg , Satoshi Fujihara , Ado, and Tori Kelly perform the game's theme song " Stranger Than Heaven ." The song will get a release this year.

The game is inspiring a live-action film on Netflix .

Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties , Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's remake of the Yakuza 3 game along with the new standalone Dark Ties title, launched as a single release for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam worldwide on February 12.
